prescreen_pool.name: DLUSD
prescreen_pool.reason: Stripe's 2026-06-03 launch announcement establishes a live DLUSD stablecoin wallet, Bridge Open Issuance as the issuance rail and Tempo as settlement. Current Deel materials establish ongoing live availability and 1:1 USD-value platform exit. Exact Bridge affiliate, token contract, direct issuer-redemption boundary and reserve allocation remain explicit unknowns rather than promotion blockers.

prescreen_pool.name: XrymaCoin
prescreen_pool.reason: The planned circulation date has passed, but the authoritative Xryma announcements page reviewed for this batch does not yet provide a separate primary-source confirmation that public issuance actually started. Do not convert a scheduled date into a live-launch fact.

prescreen_pool.name: Open USD
prescreen_pool.reason: Open Standard's current official FAQ still states that Open USD will launch later this year. External platform integration language does not override the operator's own not-yet-launched statement for SOG canonical promotion.

prescreen_pool.name: Gaia GUSD
prescreen_pool.reason: Existing protected pending candidate. April announcement described a future Q2 launch; strong primary live-launch evidence and exact issuer boundary remain unresolved.

boundary: DLUSD advances because primary sources establish actual launch and continuing live product use. No other candidate is promoted merely because an announced launch date has arrived or because an integration partner describes future availability.
